_schema: docs/SYSTEM_TABLES.md §5 路线表. Routes are undirected — `from`/`to` only fix how the brief reads. A route you do not know cannot be travelled even between two cities you know: that is pillar P2.

brief.zh: 春秋两季的定期船，沿达尔马提亚、克里特、塞浦路斯跳岛而行。冬天没有船长肯接这趟活。
brief.en: The season galley, island-hopping by Dalmatia, Crete and Cyprus. No master will take the contract in winter.

brief.zh: 亚得里亚海南下再穿爱琴海。每一处海峡都有人收钱，账要提前算好。
brief.en: Down the Adriatic and through the Aegean. Every strait has somebody collecting; budget for it in advance.

brief.zh: 沿小亚细亚南岸北上，途中在罗得或塞浦路斯补水。
brief.en: North along the Anatolian shore, watering at Rhodes or Cyprus.

brief.zh: 翻过黎巴嫩山的短路，六天。山口上有人收过路钱，也有人不收——那种更让人担心。
brief.en: Six days over the Lebanon. At the pass some men take a toll and some do not — the second kind is more worrying.

brief.zh: 经阿勒颇、摩苏尔北上，越过两河的上游。冬季山口封雪，商队宁可绕远。
brief.en: North by Aleppo and Mosul, across the headwaters of the two rivers. Snow shuts the passes in winter and caravans go the long way round.

brief.zh: 穿安纳托利亚高原，经锡瓦斯、埃尔祖鲁姆入伊儿汗地界。高原上的冬天来得早。
brief.en: Across the Anatolian plateau by Sivas and Erzurum into Ilkhanid ground. Winter arrives early up there.

brief.zh: 取道巴格达的旧商路，沿途驿栈完整，但要过两道边界。
brief.en: The old road by Baghdad — the caravanserais are intact, but there are two frontiers to cross.

brief.zh: 叙利亚朝觐大队，一年一次，沿汉志路南下。它出发时你若不在，就得等一年，或自己走。
brief.en: The Syrian hajj caravan, once a year, south along the Hijaz road. Miss its departure and you wait a year — or go alone.

brief.zh: 沿海岸经加沙北上的官道，马穆鲁克的驿站一站接一站——有文书者可换马。
brief.en: The coastal post road by Gaza. The Mamluk stations run one to the next, and a man with papers changes horses at each.

brief.zh: 沿北非海岸东行，或搭船，或跟着马格里布的朝觐队走陆路。两条都要一个月。
brief.en: East along the Barbary shore, by ship or with the Maghribi pilgrim band overland. Either way, a month.

brief.zh: 先横穿东部沙漠到红海的港口，再乘船渡到吉达。埃及朝觐大队每年走这条。
brief.en: Across the eastern desert to the Red Sea, then by ship to Jidda. The Egyptian hajj caravan takes this road each year.

brief.zh: 经莱伊、内沙布尔、木鹿东行，穿过呼罗珊。站赤已通，有金牌者快一半。
brief.en: East by Rayy, Nishapur and Merv, across Khurasan. The yam runs here: with a paiza the road is halved.

brief.zh: 南下经亚兹德、克尔曼，最后一段是波罗称为「令人厌倦」的荒漠。
brief.en: South by Yazd and Kerman, ending in the waste Polo calls wearisome.

brief.zh: 经喀什、和田或吐鲁番，绕塔克拉玛干，出敦煌入河西。全程三个月，沿途没有第二条路。
brief.en: By Kashgar and Khotan or Turfan, round the Taklamakan, out at Dunhuang into the corridor. Three months, and no second road.

brief.zh: 出红海转阿拉伯海，沿阿曼岸北上入海湾。逆季风时无船肯走。
brief.en: Out of the Red Sea into the Arabian, north along the Oman shore into the Gulf. Against the monsoon nobody sails.

brief.zh: 横渡阿拉伯海。东北季风送你南下，西南季风把你送回来——季节错了，船就在港里等。
brief.en: Across the Arabian Sea. The northeast monsoon carries you down, the southwest brings you back — out of season the ship simply waits in port.

brief.zh: 马拉巴尔直放亚丁、再入红海到吉达。朝觐季的船票贵一倍，但船多。
brief.en: Malabar straight to Aden, then up the Red Sea to Jidda. In the pilgrimage season the fare doubles — but so does the shipping.

brief.zh: 绕锡兰、经孟加拉湾东行。西南季风起时开船，晚了就要在苏门答剌等半年。
brief.en: Round Ceylon and east across the Bay of Bengal. Sail when the southwest monsoon sets in; late, and you wait half a year in Sumatra.

brief.zh: 过占城、绕海南北上。夏季西南风送舶入港，冬季反向。台风季另算。
brief.en: By Champa and round Hainan. The summer southwesterly brings the ships in, the winter wind takes them out. Typhoon season is its own reckoning.

brief.zh: 北上入御河，运河上舟楫相衔，日夜不绝。慢，但一路有官驿，无盗。
brief.en: North to the Imperial canal, where the boats run bow to stern day and night. Slow, but stationed the whole way and free of robbers.
